{{Top|leg}}
'''Jokot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who regularly played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] at [[The White Door]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Akmalla]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. He was often seen playing with [[Lar-Odo]] and [[Bonna Noot]].
